prompts.title: Neon Profile Creator
prompts.prompt: Using the attached reference photo, keep the person's face, hairstyle, skin tone and features exactly the same. Dress the person in a premium black fitted outfit with elegant details and a sophisticated wristwatch. Position the person confidently, standing beside a futuristic transparent blue neon display, with one hand presenting a glowing social media profile card featuring a circular profile portrait, beautiful city skyline cover image, follower statistics, and elegant follow and message buttons.
